paras: Application: Ford Focus ST and Focus RS MK3 EcoBoost Part Type: Fuel surge tank install kit (FST-R and pumps not included) Part Number: 20-0365

The Radium Fuel Surge Tank Install Kit fits a Radium FST-R (Fuel Surge Tank, Regulated) to the MK3 Ford Focus ST and RS to eliminate fuel starvation in all driving conditions. The surge tank pump replaces and mimics the OEM fuel supply line, feeding the factory high-pressure fuel pump, while the OEM low-pressure pump is redirected to keep the surge tank full. Overflow fuel returns to the OEM filler hose through a billet adapter.
hl: Starvation Protection: OEM low-pressure pump keeps the surge tank full
OEM-Style Feed: Surge tank pump feeds the factory high-pressure fuel pump
Overflow Return: Billet adapter returns overflow to the OEM filler hose
Flexible Regulation: Vacuum referenced for 1:1 pressure, or static
Collision-Safe Mounting: Under the vehicle, in front of the rear bumper support
Heat Shielding: Heat tape protects the unit from exhaust heat
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Surge Tank Install Kit for Ford Focus ST LW/LZ 13-18/Ford Focus RS LZ 2016-2017
